title: Vote for PS5 GOTM in October 2026 Ahead of GTA6
description: Push Square has launched its PS5 Game of the Month poll for October 2026. Discover how an exceptionally busy month sets the stage for GTA6.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## The Final Stretch Before GTA6: October's PS5 Release Wave

As the gaming community looks ahead to the monumental arrival of GTA6, October has earned a very special reputation as simply 'the month before GTA 6.' Yet, far from being a quiet lead-up period, the past 31 days proved to be an incredibly busy stretch for new PS5 releases, following hot on the heels of an equally manic September.

Gaming outlet Push Square has officially opened its latest Game of the Month (GOTM) poll, inviting players to decide which title truly defined October on the PS5. Given the sheer volume of new games that dropped over the course of the month, this upcoming poll promises to be one of the most intriguing and closely watched competitions of the year.

### A Packed Schedule Ahead of the Rstar Phenomenon

Industry analysis suggests that developers and publishers were keen to launch their titles during this window, anticipating the seismic market shift that GTA6 will inevitably bring upon its release. The back-to-back heavy release schedules of September and October have given PS5 owners an embarrassment of riches, ensuring no shortage of experiences to dive into.

As the community casts their votes on Push Square to crown October's finest, it serves as a fitting reminder of just how vibrant the current hardware ecosystem is right now, even as all roads eventually lead to Grand Theft Auto VI.

## Editor's Take
It is fascinating to see the PS5 lineup remain so robust and packed with heavy-hitting releases right on the doorstep of GTA6. October delivered an impressive slate of games, making this GOTM poll a tough choice for players. Enjoy this final burst of diverse gaming before the entire industry shifts its gaze to Rockstar's next masterpiece.
